summary: Khanna co-sponsored the Block the Bombs Act and a genocide-recognition measure, declared "Zero Aid to Israel" at a 2026 DNC meeting, and earned TrackAIPAC's endorsement after a 2024 red-card. Votes through 2024 affirming Israel's right to exist, sanctioning Palestinian militant-group backers, and condemning "from the river to the sea" predate this shift. A January 2026 Yea on an appropriations package carrying $3.3 billion in Israeli military aid stands as a recorded contradiction he attributed to provisions "snuck" into the bill.
